text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any visual hallucinations, such as seeing insects or small animals, or experienced episodes of sleepwalking or acting out dreams? I also need to know if you have any history of Parkinson's disease or other movement disorders.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Right leg weakness and unsteady gait. I also have Forgetfulness, Paranoid and agitated behavior, Difficulty in using kitchen appliances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of rapid cognitive decline, visual hallucinations, and movement issues, I need to check for specific markers. REQUEST TEST: EEG. I also need to see brain imaging to rule out structural causes. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain.
